messages:
marta: tiny bit of non-work news — accepted the Senior PM role today!! :tada: also getting married in our backyard Sept 18. low-key celebration, would love to have a Redwood mini-potluck if folks are around. not sure about a registry, tbd.
chris: OMG congrats!!! :tada: when do we bring cake?
olivia: double congrats marta, that’s huge. count me in for potluck. i can bring empanadas or a big salad.
zoe: yesss celebrate!! can we do a small card + group photo? would love to put something in the team budget (if ok).
aaron: congrats marta!!! also can help with setup/teardown. i’ll bring folding tables if needed.
people-ops: huge congrats! we can cover a $100 team gift + card. ping me if you want us to coordinate a contribution or order a group gift. :shipit:
lunchbot: Poll: which day works for a small Redwood team meetup before Sept? 1) Aug 30 lunch 2) Sept 8 after-work 3) Sept 15 brunch — vote with :one: :two: :three:
marta: thanks everyone ❤️ leaning toward a late-afternoon quick standup-style toast during the Sept 8 after-work slot if that gets the most votes. fine to bring partners to the backyard picnic too — will confirm capacity.
chris: RSVP for Sept 8. +1 for partners.
note: (reaction: :tada: x6)
olivia: i’ll bring a dessert (gluten-free option). also happy to collect messages for a card.
zoe: can we tape a little sign that says "Team Redwood" for photos? :)
aaron: on cake duty if ppl want a classic simple chocolate — or we can coordinate a bakery run.
marta: fun — i’ll DM people-ops to set up the gift and share address for cards. thanks again, everyone — feels surreal. humbly accepting hugs and coffee. :blush:
